sources.entry: Seaglass - A truly native Matrix client for macOS.

summary.one_liner: Seaglass is a native macOS client for the Matrix chat protocol, written in Swift with the Cocoa UI framework.
summary.what_it_does: Seaglass is a macOS desktop client for Matrix, built in Swift on Cocoa. It can log in to an existing Matrix homeserver and create, leave, join and part rooms and direct chats. Users can invite others with /invite, send emotes with /me, redact messages, and post Markdown-formatted text. It supports end-to-end encryption, including enabling encryption in rooms, verifying or blacklisting devices, exporting and importing keys compatible with Riot, and requesting keys from other clients. It also shows inline images and stickers and links to other attachments.
use_cases: chatting on Matrix from a Mac
managing Matrix rooms and direct messages
importing or exporting Matrix encryption keys
native desktop alternative to a web Matrix client
how_to_run: Open Seaglass.xcworkspace in Xcode and build
notable: Truly native macOS client for Matrix, written in Swift with Cocoa
Per-device verification and blacklisting for encryption
Installable via Homebrew Cask with built-in auto-updates
caveats: Early development; the author says it may be buggy and unreliable
Building from source requires Xcode 9.4 or 10.0 on macOS 10.13 (High Sierra) or later
The author is not an experienced Swift developer and says the code may be rough
